basic_info.description: Located on a quiet, tree-lined street, this charming 2BR/1BA condo offers a unique blend of modern upgrades and classic details. The living and dining rooms boast green outlooks, a wood-burning fireplace and custom gumwood built-ins. The updated kitchen flows seamlessly from the dining room, with a vintage stove and ceiling that invokes nostalgia while a generous pantry and in-unit laundry room add modern convenience Luxurious bathroom with  heated floors and a heated towel rack for ultimate comfort. Both bedrooms overlook a lush, south-facing shared backyard, providing a serene escape from the city bustle. California Closets in the bedrooms and hallway maximize storage and organization. Soundproofing in the ceiling minimizes noise transfer and the home is wired for sound. The seismically upgraded garage offers 1-car tandem parking and storage. A shared flex room behind the garage offers even more storage options. Walk Score 99. Transit Score 100! Moments away from Dolores Park, Whole Foods, dining and cafes. Enjoy an exceptional urban lifestyle with verdant green views from many rooms!
